name: Mucho Ojo (Mojo Ojo)
author: Hmdurlzy
bootlegger: • There will only be a max of n+1 different types of townsfolk in play, where n is the number of minions: 1 minion = 2 townsfolk types, 2 minions = 3 townsfolk types, etc. There is only one type of outsider in play. • If an Ojo chooses a character which is in play, all players of that type die, not just one player. If the Ojo does not choose an in-play character, a max of one player dies (it should not end the game: in final 3, the storyteller may choose that nobody dies). • For bluffs, the Ojo will be shown 1 outsider that is in play, 1 townsfolk that is in play, and 1 townsfolk that is not in play—but they will not be told which townsfolk is in play and which is not. • An alchemist pit-hag that chooses to change the demon will be told to choose differently; pit-hag abilities can turn a player into an in-play character.
